goal.request: Strengthen visual-semantic data and candidate-pack coverage from the referenced mythology-keyword research while preventing broad labels and named cultural variants from becoming unsupported universal pixel rules.

evidence.claim: The referenced conversation supplies a broad research inventory spanning thirty-eight mythology categories and hundreds of terms, but does not itself distinguish hard single-frame obligations from advisory vocabulary.

Scholarly, museum, and official cultural sources support bounded creation, realm-connection, fate-role, status-transition, underworld-descent, judgment, preservation, and combat-order relations while exposing tradition-specific variation and terminology limits.

Runtime data now contains ten narrow five-component visual profiles and sixty candidates arranged as ten complete six-slot motif clusters, with broad mythology vocabulary kept outside exact activation terms.

JSON and JSONL parsing, dictionary metadata validation, a registry-bound visual index with 189 profiles and 1090 exact terms, and a sharded semantic index with 7560 entries all pass their validation commands.
evidence.artifact: validate_photo_prompt_dictionary.py reported valid metadata; build_visual_profile_index.py --check reported 189 profiles and 1090 exact terms; eval_semantic.py --check-index reported status ok with 7560 entries

evidence.claim: Focused mythology tests pass direct exact-term routing, broad and adjacent negative controls, candidate completeness, profile structure, evidence binding, and runtime extension loading.

The broader visual-obligation and retrieval run passed 34 tests and 170 subtests but failed six yandere fixture assertions because clinical_nursing_duty_system also matched nurse text; replay against the HEAD registry and current registry produced identical clinical-nursing matches, so this failure is outside the mythology change.
evidence.artifact: pytest tests/test_photo_visual_obligations.py tests/test_photo_visual_profile_retrieval.py: 34 passed, 6 failed; diagnostic HEAD-registry versus current-registry replay returned identical matches for the five affected fixture inputs

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: A narrow requested mythology motif resolves into inspectable actor, object or realm, relation, transition, and consequence evidence with explicit nearest-neighbor rejections, while broad and culture-only vocabulary remains advisory.

invariants.statement: Every implemented mythology profile requires five independent observable component groups, five prompt evidence fields, and five render gates rather than a famous label, prop, glow, or atmosphere.
causal_controls: direct motif phrase activates only its intended profile
close visual substitute remains a negative control
partial or disconnected evidence remains failure

invariants.statement: Only narrow exact motif phrases create hard duties; BM25F, embedding similarity, broad mythology labels, deity names, and culture names can propose candidates but cannot independently create a hard obligation.
causal_controls: twenty-four broad terms are held out as direct negatives
exact activation lists omit bare axis mundi apotheosis katabasis flood and dragon

invariants.statement: Named traditions preserve their own cast and iconography, and package or prompt success is never reported as historical authenticity, rendered-pixel fidelity, religious truth, or user approval.
causal_controls: generic comparative motifs do not copy named museum objects
Egyptian judgment and Greek Moirai remain culture-specific profiles
render and user evaluation remain unscored

flexible_dimensions: camera lighting and photographic treatment that preserve all evidence
tradition-specific agents objects and realm names supplied by the requester
original unreadable ornament and material design
explicit requester definitions that override a generic comparative default

mismatches.source_state: The referenced conversation groups myth types deities cultures artifacts motifs and narrative abstractions into one broad keyword inventory.
mismatches.render_state: Only a small subset has separable actor relation transition and consequence evidence stable enough for a fail-closed single-frame contract.

mismatches.source_state: Common representations reduce fate to a thread, flood to a boat, apotheosis to glow, katabasis to a cave, and cosmic creation to a decorative egg or tree.
mismatches.render_state: The target requires the same object to participate in a visible role sequence or state transition whose consequence remains attributable in one frame.

mismatches.source_state: Comparative labels such as world-parent separation axis mundi flood myth and Chaoskampf can obscure differences among named texts and living cultural traditions.
mismatches.render_state: The target retains only the abstract relation in generic candidates and requires named variants to keep source-specific cast objects and lineage without iconographic mixing.

hypotheses.statement: Five independent component groups and explicit rejects will prevent a famous object or atmosphere from substituting for the requested mythology event.
hypotheses.falsifier: A close substitute such as a storm boat decorative egg generic scale or dragon fight activates one of the ten new hard profiles.

hypotheses.statement: Binding one aesthetic subject action location prop and composition candidate per motif will make candidate selection preserve the event chain instead of accumulating isolated mythology nouns.
hypotheses.falsifier: A motif manifest omits a slot references a missing candidate or allows one candidate to serve unrelated motif clusters.

hypotheses.statement: Narrow exact terms plus broad-term negative controls will keep culture names deity names and comparative labels from creating unsupported universal duties.
hypotheses.falsifier: A bare term such as myth world tree axis mundi fate apotheosis katabasis Anubis flood or dragon hard-activates a new profile.

intervention.general_rule: Promote only narrow mythology meanings whose actor object or realm relation transition and consequence can all be falsified in one still; keep broad taxonomy and named cultural variation advisory until explicitly bound.
intervention.generalization_basis: The component-and-confound method applies across creation transitions realm connections distributed roles status changes directed journeys judgment systems preservation chains and combat consequences without assuming one universal mythology appearance.

covered_axes: generic thread glow cave and scales

decision.rationale: The research ledger, ten fail-closed profiles, sixty runtime-loaded candidates, regenerated indexes, and focused exact and negative-control tests pass at package and prompt-behavior layers. The broader regression failures reproduce with the HEAD registry and concern a pre-existing nurse-to-yandere fixture interaction, not a mythology profile. No render or user evidence was collected, so the work is implemented but not promoted as pixel fidelity, cultural approval, or aesthetic success.
